technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Integrated production

# Included processes
The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control and harvest. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering is included. Inputs of fertilisers, pesticides and seed as well as their transports to the farm (1km) are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, pilot network, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services, information provided by retailers and expert knowledge. The production data were verified and adjusted by a group of experts.
